description: DB-M14 provider identity catalogue. All providers are Enabled=false and Configured=false: NO provider is operational. Capability-support flags are provisional metadata for future routing; they must be verified before any milestone enables a provider. SecretReference holds an env-var NAME only - never a value. W7D TASK 1: the openai entry's reference was reconciled from OPENAI_API_KEY to the approved NEXUS_OPENAI_API_KEY. The remaining four references (DEEPSEEK_/ANTHROPIC_/GEMINI_/OPENROUTER_API_KEY) are LEFT AS THEY ARE ON PURPOSE: those providers have no Ai:Registry entry and no approved reference, so renaming them would fabricate a NEXUS_ approval for a provider nobody has assessed. They are unratified seed values for disabled providers, not an approval of vendor-conventional secret ownership. A provider whose reference IS ratified must use the approved NEXUS_ name in every file that declares it - enforced by W7dSecretReferenceConsistencyTests.

providers.Notes: DB-M14 seed. DeepSeek is reached via its Anthropic-compatible endpoint (deepcode.ps1 maps DEEPSEEK_API_KEY to ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN). Streaming/tools confirmed because the current manual flow runs Claude Code against it. Other flags are provisional and not yet verified.

DB-M14 seed. ChatGPT is used today for prompt generation (human-mediated); this record describes the provider as a future routable provider. Not enabled. W7D TASK 1: SecretReference was OPENAI_API_KEY, which disagreed with the approved runtime reference NEXUS_OPENAI_API_KEY carried by appsettings (Platform:Providers:OpenAI:ApiKeyRef and Ai:Registry:Providers[openai].SecretReference). The vendor-conventional name was the older of the two and is not the estate's canonical reference; it was reconciled to NEXUS_OPENAI_API_KEY, which remains the one approved name. This is a NAME and never a value: the historical credential behind it still requires human rotation and was not read, copied, tested or exposed.
